workflows.header:
name: Verify external NPU adapters

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 3 * * 1'

name: Check deployed device

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: 'Health is read-only; benchmark and soak perform configured ASR/TTS inference'
        required: true
        default: health
        type: choice
        options: [health, benchmark, soak]
      allow_inference:
        description: 'Explicitly allow ASR/TTS calls (may use a paid cloud provider)'
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      manifest:
        description: 'Reviewed manifest path in the default branch'
        default: ci/device.package.json
        type: string
      baseline_run_id:
        description: 'Optional successful run ID for the same mode/device/manifest'
        required: false
        type: string
      allow_config_change:
        description: 'Accept deployed config hash changes for this parameter experiment'
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean

name: Build lang Ubuntu 20.04 packages

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Optional Debian version, for example 0.1.1'
        required: false
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [master]
    tags: ['lang-v*']
    paths:
      - 'lang/**'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'klar/**'
      - '.github/workflows/lang-linux-package.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lang/**'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'klar/**'
      - '.github/workflows/lang-linux-package.yml'

name: Compare orchestration performance

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      baseline_ref:
        description: 'Baseline commit, tag or branch; empty means the default branch'
        required: false
        type: string
      baseline_variant:
        description: 'Optional same-run parameter experiment: baseline variant ID (for example split-12)'
        required: false
        type: string
      candidate_variant:
        description: 'Optional candidate variant ID (for example split-20-16k); fill both IDs'
        required: false
        type: string
